description: Let \(M\) be a given externally countable transitive ZFC-model, with \(M\models\text{“}P\text{ is ccc and }|P|=\kappa\ge\aleph_0\text{”}\). For every \(M\)-generic \(G\), the extension satisfies \(2^{\aleph_0}\le(\kappa^{\aleph_0})^M\), and the displayed old cardinal remains a cardinal there.
